fields.label: Item base-value multiplier
fields.description: Game base value times this number, then converted to contribution. Default 1. Melange has a separate rate. Restart after changes.

fields.label: Solari value per Melange
fields.description: Default 60000. Whole Melange units are spent; review actual contribution. Restart after changes.

fields.label: Solari cost per contribution point
fields.description: Default 1000. Maximum 6000 contribution per transaction. Restart after changes.

fields.label: Award specialization XP
fields.description: Award matching specialization XP after confirmed donations. No XP at maximum level. Restart after changes.

fields.label: Specialization XP per contribution point
fields.description: Default 1. Fractional total XP is rounded down. Restart after changes.
